summary: BUG-0174/BUG-0175: return 405 for a wrong method on pool advertise and serve an empty storage-cluster proof list as a JSON array; clarify intended reserve-release and verify-target behavior in the peer contract. API impact: existing contract.

guide.reason: Internal Core peer protocol hygiene; no operator workflow changes.

api.reason: Existing contract: advertise documents 405 with Allow: POST; proof returns an empty JSON array with application/json (older Cores may return null, treated identically); reserve release and verify target rules clarified as intended. Callers and mixed-version pools are unaffected.

verification.method: Regression tests failed on the old handlers and pass with the fixes; agent normal/race suites, API contract tests, docs gate and privacy test pass.
